description:
We are looking for a System Software Engineer to join our team within the Thermal Management Business Unit. This role is a great fit for a developing engineer who is excited about embedded Linux systems and wants to play a hands-on role in building the software that drives next-generation datacenter cooling solutions.

 You will work under general supervision on moderate-scope projects, growing your skills in Board Support Package (BSP) development, sensor integration, and datacenter management protocols. Our team is based in Georgetown, TX, operating as Strategic Thermal Labs, a startup-energy group within Vertiv on a mission to produce the world's highest-performing, most efficient heat transfer solutions for the data center industry. If you are looking for more than just a job and want to contribute to something that genuinely matters, this could be a career-defining opportunity.

 Responsibilities 

 
 Contribute to the development and maintenance of Board Support Packages (BSPs) for embedded Linux controllers

 Develop software to interface with and control a variety of sensors (temperature, humidity, pressure, airflow) under the guidance of senior engineers

 Implement communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART) to facilitate data exchange between sensors, microcontrollers, and the main embedded Linux system

 Support integration of datacenter management protocols such as Modbus, Redfish API, and BACNet into embedded platforms

 Execute software test plans including unit and integration testing, and assist with system-level testing efforts

 Perform debugging and root cause analysis of software and hardware issues with support from senior team members

 Create and maintain technical documentation including design specifications and API documentation

 Provide informal guidance and support to new team members on embedded development workflows and best practices

 
 Qualifications 

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline

 2 to 4 years of experience developing embedded system or microcontroller software

 Working knowledge of embedded Linux systems and Board Support Package development

 Hands-on experience interfacing with and controlling various types of sensors

 Programming proficiency in Python with experience in embedded application development

 Familiarity with communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, and UART

 Understanding of software testing methodologies including unit and integration testing

 Ability to manage multiple tasks and collaborate with cross-functional teams

 
 Nice to Have   

 
 Exposure to datacenter management protocols such as Modbus, Redfish API, or BACNet

 Experience with Raspberry Pi or similar single-board computer platforms

 Familiarity with security considerations in embedded systems

 Experience with version control systems and CI/CD pipelines for embedded software

 
   

 If  YOU  are the person we are looking for, feel free to apply and let's start drafting your future career in a healthy and growing environment!

 The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.  

 OUR CORE PRINCIPALS : Safety .  Integrity.  Respect.  Teamwork.  Inclusion. 

 OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES 

 •  High-Performance Culture 

 • Customer Focus 

 •  Operational Excellence 

 •  Innovation 

 •  Financial Strength 

 VERTIV BEHAVIORS 

 
 Own it 

 Act with urgency 

 Foster a customer-first mindset 

 Think big and execute 

 Lead by example 

 Drive continuous improvement 

 Learn and seek out development 

 Promote transparent & open communication  

 
 About Vertiv 

 Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs.  Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.   

 Work Authorization 

 No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

 Equal Opportunity Employer 

 Vertiv is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We promote equal opportunities for all with respect to hiring, terms of employment, mobility, training, compensation, and occupational health, without discrimination as to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression (including transgender status or sexual stereotypes), genetic information, citizenship status, national origin, protected veteran status, political affiliation, or disability. If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, you can request help by sending an email to  help.join@vertiv.com .
